change: exact stay/switch one-step simulator transitions in a separate rare replay buffer; quota 8 of 64
thresholdRole: classify training states only; no PHY probability or action masking changes
unmodified: 11 original features plus best visible success
diagnosticPolicy: frozen 100-episode context model; first action changed once then same frozen policy
futureLeakageProtection: diagnostic returns never used as targets
learner uses immediate one-second reward and next state only
training seeds only for augmented transitions
budgetCaveat: additional simulator queries produce paired data, so environment-interaction budget is not identical; optimizer steps and primary episodes are identical
samplingCaveat: fixed rare quota intentionally changes training-state weighting; no importance correction, not a PHY or reward change
seedCaveat: one initialization per method; 92 diagnostic decision times from correlated trajectories are not 92 independent trials
